scope: Local-only independent S02 source-lane review. Root retains deployment, database execution, budget and provider admission.

findings.detail: RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE is classified PARSER by the worker; failure_v1 requires TRANSPORT_READ before treating HTTP200/no wire hash as UNCERTAIN_EFFECT. Remove the class restriction and exercise retained lease in actual rollback.

Current S02 commit/normalize/derive lack an admitted relation-byte guard after inserting source/raw/observed/expected rows. Provider pre-fetch check does not bound later duplication. Add a hash-bound helper and actual resource-hold rollback case.
failure_v1 checks active attempt but does not call context/bundle verification before releasing or retaining the lease. Add the context check.

Source/page conflict checks omit some provider/retrieved/null-historical-time fields; DERIVE rechecks source hash/bytes but not URI/wire lineage. Strengthen immutable metadata assertions while editing.

NORMALIZE rejects an already-normalized page before existing-row replay comparisons. Permit exact no-new-row replay or explicitly qualify this contract, and exercise immutable raw/observed/expected tamper detection in the rollback fixture.

confirmed_design: Fixed provider origin/path and Jul15–Sep30 settlement scope, 1000-result page and one-page initial admission.
Reserved request precedes provider credential use; exact attempt token and owner/stop checks remain mandatory.
Strict total body/runtime limits; no unknown-outcome automatic refetch.
Top-level cursor credential redaction preserves original numeric result lexemes, distinct stored/wire hashes and source bytes.
Scheduled publication DATEs are distinct from unknown exact publication, historical receipt and availability timestamps.
July support and September30/October9 scheduled publication are represented without false September availability.
Duplicate raw occurrences are preserved; identical versions deduplicate, changed business-key versions are marked conflicting.
Company/security identifiers remain null; generic denominator is provisional and REPAIR explicitly holds for cohort/report/temporal evidence.
Worker file SHA equals pinned registration/notes hash.
limits: No actual SQL compilation or rollback was performed by this reviewer.
Official source/calendar contract was supplied as root-verified evidence; no fresh web lookup was performed in this local-only review.
The actual provider archive and company-level completeness remain unverified.
Implementation page ceiling is not budget authority.
This snapshot is pre-fix; review owned-file diffs and rerun actual root rollback after patches.

final_targeted_recheck.notes: Unknown HTTP200 guard, pre/post resource guards, failure bundle check, source metadata and no-new-row replay/tamper assertions reviewed. Separately flagged missing release_id on replay lookups for performance in light of observed D02 issue.
